intent: The row that lays out a Questionnaire's navigation buttons, Previous at the start and Skip plus Next or Submit at the end.
typical_uses: The navigation row under the questions

dont_use_when.situation: A row of buttons outside a questionnaire

instead.note: QuestionnaireActions is a fixed three-cell grid for the four navigation buttons and holds nothing else; ButtonGroup joins buttons into one attached row, which is a different layout.

invariants.text: questionnaire.module.css places each button in a fixed cell of a three-column grid - Previous in the first, Skip in the second, Next and Submit sharing the third - whatever their source order.

anti_patterns.dont: Mount only the buttons the current item needs
anti_patterns.do_instead: Mount all four every time; each hides itself (native `hidden` and `inert`) when it does not apply, and Next and Submit swap within one cell

bad.title: Next and Submit chosen by the caller
bad.why: The root already hides whichever of the two does not apply; picking one by hand duplicates that state and drifts when an item is disabled or the flow moves under the caller.
